title: Fix Elements Palette Font URLs
description: Fix Failed to decode downloaded font / OTS invalid sfntVersion 1008821359 by correcting palette @font-face URLs and ensuring all Vite play apps serve elements/assets at /assets.
summary: Fixed palette @font-face URLs: codegen used ../../../../assets (resolved to repo-root assets/) so browsers received index.html instead of WOFF2 (sfntVersion 1008821359 = <?xm). Switched emitPaletteFonts to /assets/ paths, regenerated palette.css, added elementsAssetsVitePlugin to spatial renderer-r3f play. Scene e2e console checks pass.
